Blank burned-in identifiers out of the image itself (declared clinical region, device template, on-device OCR and Redact Regions, unioned). Burned In Annotation = YES is cleaned; absent, OCR decides; NO is trusted and the pixels are left alone. Off = header only; files whose pixels may still carry PHI are refused.

The two modes differ in which way they fail. header: redact only text matching the file's own PHI or a PHI-shaped pattern; scales, legends and annotations survive. Fails open — text the header never carried is kept. classify: adds PHI keywords, keeping only text on the clinical allowlist; fails closed. To erase an area whatever it reads, use Redact Region.

Blank only the text OCR flagged (and any Redact Regions), at its exact position — no automatic banner band from the declared Ultrasound Regions or the device template. Pair with OCR Mode header to remove exactly the study's own identifiers, institution and dates. Drops the band safety net; verify visually.
OCR every frame instead of the first/middle/last sample
Rectangles to blank as x,y,width,height, unioned with the automatic sources (always applied, even when Burned In Annotation = NO). Separate with “ ; ”.

blank: fill only. label: a fixed stamp drawn into the blanked box. replace: the header engine's own de-identified value for the matched attribute (needs OCR mode classify or header; uncertain regions get the label). The region is always blanked first.
Stamp text for the label style (and the replace fallback)
What blanked regions are filled with: black (stored value 0) or white (the largest stored value at the image's bit depth, resolved per file).

After cleaning: source mirrors the input transfer syntax (lossy sources are re-quantized), or any dicom-compress codec. Empty = Explicit VR Little Endian. Redacted regions are re-verified blank after re-encoding.
